content: Happy Flowers. Can I help you?
I'd like to order some roses. Can you give me some ideas?
Well, sending red roses means romance, and sending yellow roses is a sign of friendship. White roses are perfect for weddings.
I'll go to a party, so maybe yellow roses are better. How much are they?
Not really. White roses are more expensive, which cost $38 a bunch. But red roses are a little bit cheaper, $32.
Can I have your name and address, please?
It's James Park, 43 Apple Street. Would you please send the flowers at 6:30 this evening? I'll pay when they're delivered.
OK. Thank you for your order.
